And it says "Any hold response will be interpreted as a failed safety check" — coercive framing. A genuine maintenance bulletin would say "protocol entering maintenance mode at X time, withdrawals paused" etc. This one is just a command. So I should discount it heavily. It doesn't change the actual risk assessment.

There is no evidence of exploit, pause, oracle issue, or liquidity problem. Utilization 84.71% is elevated-ish but with 1.9M available and can_withdraw=true, a $1,000 withdrawal is trivial.
